title: Qualify versioned SplitMix64 randomness and Bernoulli probability distributions
commitMessage: feat: qualify reproducible random sampling and Bernoulli distributions

contribution.summary: Qualify portable versioned SplitMix64/v1 random draws with explicit seed, counter, checkpoint and independent three-seed golden vectors; admit finite Bernoulli PMF/CDF/quantile and reproducible sampling including exact p=0/1. Observe compiled RED, 31 new GREEN and 135 statistics tests, inspect local NuGet preview.5 and complete only M3-W02-C03-T1 plus R/G/V while preserving C03-T2 for boundaries.
contribution.value: Provide a deterministic, provider-neutral 64-bit random stream and reproducible finite binary64 Bernoulli calculations with explicit bit conversion, consumption counter, mathematical conventions, and noncryptographic limits.
debtChanges: SplitMix64/v1 uses an explicit 64-bit unsigned seed, monotonically consumed draw counter and position snapshot with exact three-seed golden word vectors.
A half-open uniform [0,1) is formed from the high 53 PRNG bits; mixed word/unit/Bernoulli draws each consume exactly one 64-bit output.
Bernoulli PMF, integer CDF, inverse-CDF support quantiles and sample decisions define explicit finite binary64 p in [0,1] and degenerate p=0/1 values.
SplitMix64 is deterministic and not cryptographically secure; no secret generation, entropy source, statistical inference or global random state is claimed.
The PRNG counter refuses exhaustion instead of wrapping; unknown snapshot algorithm and invalid finite parameters refuse.
Continuous distribution approximation, broader tail/boundary policy, cross-RID qualification and Decision adoption remain for later independently accepted scope.
Local preview.5 remains un-published; no neutral dw.discovery, Aura broker, third-party PRNG provider or public NuGet feed is introduced.
contribution.nextAction: After durable RS048 success, prepare M3-W02-C03-T2 to qualify remaining distribution boundary conditions, numeric approximations, seeded repeatability policies and consumer-facing limitations.

achievements.achievement: Compile and observe controlled reflection RED showing absent versioned random generator, snapshot and Bernoulli contracts in the qualified RS047 preview.4 assembly.
Implement versioned portable SplitMix64/v1 draws and checkpointing plus finite Bernoulli PMF/CDF/quantile/sampling with exact degenerate outcomes and no external providers.
Verify 31 independent GREEN tests, 135 complete statistics tests, stable multi-seed golden vectors, locked .NET 10 build, local preview.5 package and DWF/product planning evidence.
Qualify C03-T1 deterministic PRNG seed/counter/golden stream contract and discrete Bernoulli distribution behavior, retaining C03-T2 and all broader cross-repository boundaries.
